title: EndpointEvent
description: Normalized endpoint or filesystem telemetry event.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the endpoint event.

event_type.description: Type of event detected on the endpoint.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when the event occurred.

source_component.description: Sensor or subsystem component identifier emitting the event.

file_path.description: Path to the affected filesystem object, if applicable.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic digest of the file, if available.

process_id.description: Process identifier (PID) associated with the event.

parent_process_id.description: Parent process identifier (PPID) associated with the event.
